faq.q: Why does this page show market numbers if they are not foreclosure numbers?
faq.a: Because S Surrey White Rock is a SnapStats-covered FVREB community, its all-property community figures can be stated as board context — detached median $1,628,000 and Condos & Townhomes median $700,000 in September 2026 — but SnapStats publishes no foreclosure cut, so no foreclosure count, share or discount figure is given here (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Can I put conditions on an offer for a foreclosure in South surrey?
faq.a: Conditions such as financing or inspection may be limited or not accepted, depending on the lender's and the court's terms. Speak to Jared and your lawyer before you write an offer.

faq.q: What is a court-ordered sale in South surrey?
faq.a: It is a sale of a property supervised by the court after a lender has taken legal action, and the sale needs court approval. Offers are usually made subject to that approval, and other buyers can sometimes bid higher at the hearing.
